title: Gemeente Zuiddrecht
$comment: The cast of the Zuiddrecht example set, and OpenRegister's own fragment: a BRP row per cast person with a BSN and a KVK row and branch per business. It also fills the public-space register (openbare ruimte) with the trees, street lights, play equipment, market pitches and road sections the cases link to; other fragments find them by `identification`. Installed with `occ openregister:example-set:install zuiddrecht`; every other app adds its part in its own lib/Settings/example-sets/zuiddrecht.json and refers to cast members with {{cast:key.field}} and to other apps' objects only through a lookup on a business key (BSN, KVK number). Zuiddrecht is fictitious. BSNs are 11-proof numbers from the BRP test block 999990000-999999999 and appear nowhere else in the fleet's registers; KVK numbers are fictitious; municipality code 9999 belongs to no municipality.

people.$comment: The example resident of the portal: portaliq's fragment writes her cases, messages and portal account. An instance that still has portaliq's old example-resident install runs `occ portaliq:example-resident:remove zuiddrecht` first.
Buurtvereniging Oost's secretary. A contact person with no BSN (he gave only a name and an address) and no account: he never signs in.
